Name: Nyapu-Style Nora the Herpetologist
Author: AlliBialystock
Description:
I love Nyapu's portraits, and I also love Nora - so I put them together. This drop-in mod contains PNG files of Nyapu replacements for Nora's portraits.

Note: This collection currently includes replacements for all of Nora's portraits [b]except [/b]her Spirit's Eve portrait. This is still a WIP and may take a while, as I'm working on other portrait mods as well.

Thank you to Nyapu for making their fantastic portraits available for free use, and thank you to bagibagriella for the blessing on my new portraits!
